Manipur Musician Beaten to Death in Delhi After Complaining About Noise

A 54-year-old musician from Manipur, C. Vikram Singh, was beaten to death in Delhi's Kilokari village after he reportedly objected to people drinking alcohol and making noise outside his apartment. The incident occurred in the Sunlight Colony police station area. Singh had gone to protest the disturbance at a nearby dhaba. A group, including delivery personnel and dhaba staff, allegedly attacked him. He sustained severe injuries and later died. Eight people have been arrested in connection with the incident.
